147-5100-5231.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5100-5231.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {R}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3413-4875-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Conspiracy, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1477-5641-7810.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing an artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
Repeat.

215-1376-3499.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-3499.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 6 or greater

215-539-2436-7781.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Marwyn
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2232-4031-4541-5705.manaNeeded: {1} if you control fewer than eight Treasures
2232-4031-4541-5705.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven Treasures.
There are at least three creatures in your party
2232-4031-4541-5705.description:
Activate at least seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {7}.
Cast Marut by paying at least {7} gained from Treasures, plus an extra up to {1} if needed.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ardent Electromancer from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marut. When Marut enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast it.
Cast Ardent Electromancer by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Electromancer enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Electromancer trigger, adding at least {R}{R}{R}
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
2232-4031-4541-5705.notes: If you control eight or more Treasures, use eight Treasures to cast Marut, which foregoes step 12.

3711-4222-6006.description:
Activate Moonfolk Puzzlemaker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Moonfolk Puzzlemaker triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Repeat.

5147-6112-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5147-6112-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Fumulus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

147-5726.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
147-5726.description:
Cast Three Steps Ahead by paying {U} plus an additional {3} to select its second mode, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Three Steps Ahead, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Three Steps Ahead, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5726.notes: If desired, you can spend an additional {2} while casting Three Steps Ahead to add its third mode, allowing you to draw your library and then discard half that many cards.

3817-4605-5231-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

628-2511-7188.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

57-1879-4846-6657.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1879-4846-6657.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2957-4365-4508-5880.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2733-5954-6664-6751.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

457-1409-6751.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve both Urza triggers, creating two 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Constructs, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

413-3086-3175.manaNeeded: {G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
413-3086-3175.description:
Cast Lagrella by paying {G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lagrella.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it, Blasting Station and Lagrella trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

3918-4899-4968.description:
Activate Trazyn using Phyrexian Devourer's ability by exiling the top card of your library, putitng a number of +1/+1 counters on Trazyn equal to the exiled card's mana value.
Repeat step 1 as many times as desired, or until your library is empty.
Activate Trazyn using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as many times as able/desired.

1495-5902-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
1495-5902-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

3277-5256-6490--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana available each turn to cast the extra turn spell and enough mana each extra turn to cast Izzet Chronarch.
You have not cast a spell using Kotis
3277-5256-6490--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Izzet Chronarch, causing you to mill cards equal to Izzet Chronarch's power.
Cast Izzet Chronarch from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile the extra turn spell.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the extra turn spell from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-3107-3653-4694.easyPrerequisites: You have created a Treasure token this turn.
1636-3107-3653-4694.description:
Activate Vazi by tapping it, causing an opponent to create at least one Treasure token.
The Treasure(s) enter the battlefield as a 0/0 creature and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Intruder Alarm and Disciple of the Vault that many times.
Resolve all Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve all Disciple of the Vault triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

710-772-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

1430-2292-5011.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Mirror Image.
When Mirror Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

575-2690-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rattleclaw Mystic, adding one mana of any color.
When Rattleclaw Mystic dies, Yedora triggers, returning Rattleclaw Mystic from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Rattleclaw Mystic by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Rattleclaw Mystic's morph ability by paying {2}, turning it face up.
Rattleclaw Mystic triggers, adding {G}{U}{R}.
Repeat.

2092-2910-4954.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 7 or greater.
2092-2910-4954.description:
Activate Castle Garenbrig's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G} and tapping it, adding six {G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Castle Garenbrig and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

198-758-4067.notablePrerequisites:
Empowered Autogenerator has at least four charge counters on it.
You have the largest deck size.
198-758-4067.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and addding {U/B}{U/B}{U/B}{U/B}{U/B}.
Activate Fathom Feeder by paying {3}{U}{B}, causing you to draw a card, and causing each opponent to exile the top card of their library.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

2051-2546-4298-4578.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
2051-2546-4298-4578.description:
Activate Tranquil Thicket's cycling ability by paying {G} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Tranquil Thicket ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Borborygmos ability, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Tranquil Thicket and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

345-1236-3466.description:
Cast Rattleblaze Scarecrow by paying {6}.
Rattleblaze Scarecrow enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Reaper King triggers, destroying Rattleblaze Scarecrow.
Rattleblaze Scarecrow dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters due to Metallic Mimic.
Repeat from step 3.

1812-1912-2034-3707-5140.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tithe Taker to add {C}{C}.
Tithe Taker triggers, creating 1/1 white and black Spirit token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token to add {C}{C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {1} to add {B}.
Activate Kenrith by paying {2}{B} to return Tithe Taker from your graveyard to battlefield.
Repeat.
